    About this analysis

    Tempo is an estimate from librosa's beat tracker and can be reported for material without a clear pulse. Bar lines assume 4/4 and start at the first detected beat; downbeats are not detected yet. Level is RMS amplitude, not a LUFS loudness measurement. Hits are scaled to this track's strongest moment, so compare them within a track, not across tracks.

    This page works offline. It embeds uPlot 1.6.32 (MIT License) and the Inter font (SIL Open Font License 1.1).
